name: qsv-blake3
description: Compute or check BLAKE3 hashes of files.

args.name: input
args.description: File/s to hash - any file type, not just CSV. Multiple paths may be given, space-separated. If not specified, or when "-" is given, reads from stdin.

options.description: Read blake3 sums from the input files and check them.
Use the key derivation mode, with the given context string. Cannot be used with --keyed.
Use the keyed mode, reading the 32-byte key from stdin. When using --keyed, file arguments are required (cannot also read data from stdin).
The number of output bytes, before hex encoding.
Disable memory mapping. Also disables multithreading.
Write output to <file> instead of stdout.
Write raw output bytes to stdout, rather than hex. Only a single input is allowed. --no-names is implied.
